runs.content: McKesson was bought at a new 52-week high (+21.9% over 3 months) on a fiscal Q1 beat, FY27 EPS guidance of $44.20–45.00 and a CVS distribution deal in principle; it is defensive healthcare momentum outside Burry's NDX/SMH shorts. COP hit T1 at $145.24 (+26.25%, 1/3 sold for ~$421). AMAT's final third was exited at $413.11 for a blended +25.49% (+$255), after Burry's SMH puts and a missed 10-16 sector-warning breach. Turso writes are pending (blocked this run). Portfolio net P&L: +$2,147 (+2.72% on $79,000).

UnitedHealth was bought after its third FY26 guidance raise (adj EPS at least $20.50) on a Q3 beat and an improving medical cost ratio (88.4%); the +5% gap faded to a flat close, so the entry is at the pre-print price. CVX hit T1 at $217.73 (+25.12%, 1/3 sold for ~$417). IAG was exited as a capacity trim (−4.00%, −$40; weakest position, no thesis break). Portfolio net P&L: +$2,041 (+2.62% on $78,000).
